body:
I tried AMT three times, first at doses of 35 and 45mg, then one at 70mg. The first two were okay. Nothing really happened. Just felt fairly mellow and content. The third time the only thing that happened was my eyesight got worse, slightly blurred and not as far-reaching as it used to be. Particularly sucks cos I'd shelled out on laser eye surgery. It's been a year now and it's still no better.
So there you go: one large dose of AMT probably damaged my eyesight forever.
Recommended? Er...no.
